title: DUND Solid 2 and Plugged Astro/Solid 1 deployed benchmark

source.note: Measurements were taken before adding the benchmark presentation to the review route. Home, catalog, and product code did not change.

environment.host: Local development workstation in Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia
environment.network: Host network, no VPN or proxy configured by the benchmark
environment.cloudflareEdgeColo: Derived from each HTTP sample cf-ray header

tools.curl: curl 8.21.0 (x86_64-pc-linux-gnu) libcurl/8.21.0 OpenSSL/3.6.3 zlib/1.3.2 brotli/1.2.0 zstd/1.5.7 libidn2/2.3.8 libpsl/0.21.5 libssh2/1.11.1 nghttp2/1.69.0 ngtcp2/1.24.0 nghttp3/1.17.0 mit-krb5/1.22.2

http.sequence: 10 route-grouped sequential samples, then 15 samples per route in one deterministic randomized order
http.cachePolicy: Only Plugged received five bounded unique-query samples per route. DUND frame documents are not shared-cacheable, so cache busting is not semantically useful.
http.failures: Curl transfers have a 10 second connect timeout and 20 second total timeout. Incomplete attempts are retained as exclusions and retried up to four times with a new bounded cache-bust key when applicable.

lighthouse.ordering: Three interleaved rounds changed route, form-factor, and target order to reduce fixed-order bias.
lighthouse.validity: A run is excluded when Lighthouse reports a runtime error, redirects to another displayed URL, or omits a required numeric metric. Up to two retries are allowed.

navigation.conditions: Desktop Chromium, 1440 × 900, unthrottled host network, one persistent browser cache per target.
navigation.duration: Browser performance.now() from click to the destination h1. A new document uses its new Performance time origin.
navigation.transfer: Chrome DevTools Protocol Network.loadingFinished encodedDataLength summed for requests that start after the click.

methodology.aggregation: Nearest-rank percentiles over valid runs. Median is p50. Lighthouse tables use three valid cold-navigation runs per case. HTTP and app-navigation retain compact per-run values.
